title: crataegus macracantha var. integriloba
intro: Crataegus macracantha var. integriloba, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a type of deciduous shrub or small tree in the Rosaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including cardiovascular and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of lowering cholesterol levels and blood pressure, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus macracantha var. integriloba include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-oxidative effects, which contribute to its overall medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
